verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents warehouse destinations that load event data without a user-defined schema, using a predefined warehouse schema. Its Profiles feature generates warehouse-native SQL to build identity-resolved customer 360 profiles in your own warehouse, and the vendor pitches storing data on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: no evidence naming support for Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or S3 specifically; no documentation of user-controlled sync or load schedules; no independent hands-on corroboration of warehouse loading.
